project_type: Python Telegram Bot (aiogram 3.x) with SQLAlchemy async ORM
test_framework: None - no tests exist in the project
verification_instructions: 1. Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt 2. Verify imports: python -c 'from bot.main import main; print(OK)' 3. Check syntax: python -m py_compile for each changed file
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. No .env file present (only .env.example), so runtime tests requiring BOT_TOKEN will fail. Validation limited to syntax and import checks.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing code patterns: async/await, aiogram 3.x Router pattern, SQLAlchemy async sessions via AsyncSessionLocal context manager.
key_patterns: 1. All DB ops use 'async with AsyncSessionLocal() as session' pattern. 2. Handlers use Router with F.text or F.data filters. 3. FSM uses StatesGroup/State classes. 4. Admin check via check_admin() helper. 5. Keyboards defined in bot/keyboards/menus.py. 6. CRUD in bot/database/crud.py. 7. Bot instance is global in main.py (antipattern to fix).
directory_structure: UFQ_EVENT_BOT_FINAL/ - root. bot/ - main package. bot/database/ - models, CRUD, DB session. bot/handlers/ - admin, events, scanner, start, user routers. bot/keyboards/ - keyboard markups. bot/middlewares/ - subscription check middleware. bot/utils/ - ticket generator, status manager.
